question: When a customer types a code that doesn't work, what should checkout do?
mermaid:
flowchart LR
  C[customer types a code] --> S{server checks it}
  S -- good --> D[discount shown]
  S -- bad --> X[?]

options.label: Say why, keep the cart
options.description: The form shows 'expired' or 'not found' under the field. Nothing else changes.

options.label: Ignore it quietly
options.description: Checkout goes ahead at full price and the code is dropped.

options.label: Ask before paying
options.description: A confirm step offers full price or another code.
options.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  B[bad code] --> Q{pay full price?}
  Q -- yes --> P[pay]
  Q -- no --> E[enter another]
